title: Mail polling works with the row-level-security enforcing pool
detail: createInboundMailSupervisor opens its own system scope for the cross-tenant reads and writes of accounts, cursors and seen messages. Before, passing the enforcing pool as db made every poll see no accounts.

title: The mail account list links to the IMAP connect form
detail: mailAccountListScreen gets a "Connect mailbox" toolbar action that opens the screen mail-account-connect-imap. The button shows only when the app mounts inbound-provider-imap, which registers that screen. The Systemcheck fix link for inbound mail now leads to a list where a mailbox can be added.

title: Apps can send from a connected mailbox
detail: The provider contract gets an optional send(ctx, account, message). The new server function sendMailFromAccount(ctx, { accountId, message }) is called from an app's own write handler and sends through the provider of the mailbox, with the mailbox address as From and In-Reply-To and References for replies. It returns WriteResult<{ messageIdHeader }>; failures are typed UnprocessableErrors with the reasons mail_send_not_configured, mail_send_login_rejected, mail_send_server_unreachable, mail_send_rejected and mail_send_invalid_message (i18n keys inboundMail.send.errors.*). A missing, disconnected or someone else's personal mailbox answers not found. There is no fallback to the app sender. New exports: sendMailFromAccount, MAIL_SEND_ERRORS, outboundMailMessageSchema, OutboundMailMessage, OutboundMailSent, MailSendNotConfiguredError, MailSendRejectedError. New keys in all locale packages.

title: Inbound-mailbox probes
detail: inbound-mail-foundation registers a probe with one result per configured mailbox. A personal mailbox is probed only when its owner starts the run, and only its owner sees the result.

title: Undecryptable mail account no longer stops polling of other accounts
detail: Any decryption failure of an account address (corrupt envelope, missing key, AAD mismatch) is logged by error class and the account is skipped; the other accounts keep polling.

title: Rename audit reason comes from the caller role
detail: update-account records tenant_admin or system_admin from the caller's roles and honors a client-supplied reason only for the system identity, so a form call can no longer write system reasons such as watch_supervisor. The rename form no longer carries a reason field and the reason payload field is optional.

title: Seen-message lookup handles listings of any size
detail: filterUnknownMessageIds queries the already seen provider message ids in chunks of 1000, so a full-mailbox listing no longer exceeds the Postgres bind parameter limit and aborts the account's poll.

title: Mailbox list accepts the screen's limit
detail: account:list accepted an empty payload only, so the projectionList screen's limit was rejected. It now takes limit up to MAX_LIST_LIMIT and returns the visible mailboxes ordered by id.

title: Declarative mailbox list and rename screens
detail: The feature registers the projectionList mail-accounts (name, address, provider, status, connected; row actions rename and disconnect) and the actionForm mail-account-edit, both restricted to SystemAdmin and TenantAdmin like the handlers. The list shows several mailboxes per tenant, never a credential. Screens are dormant, so the app places the list in its own nav. MAIL_ACCOUNT_LIST_SCREEN_ID and MAIL_ACCOUNT_EDIT_SCREEN_ID are exported.
migration: Place mail-accounts in the app nav with r.nav; no other change.

title: The deprecated inboundMailFoundationFeature constant is removed
detail: inboundMailFoundationFeature was kept next to createInboundMailFoundationFeature() for one release. Mount the feature by calling createInboundMailFoundationFeature().
migration: Run bun kumiko-upgrade --apply. It replaces inboundMailFoundationFeature with createInboundMailFoundationFeature().

title: Inbound mail fetch can skip already-seen message ids
detail: InboundMailProviderPlugin.fetch receives an optional filterUnknownMessageIds(providerMessageIds) hook. The watch supervisor implements it with a tenant- and account-scoped lookup of already-seen provider message ids and returns the ids not seen yet, so a plugin can avoid downloading messages it has already processed.

title: InboundMailContext exposes metricsFor to provider plugins
detail: InboundMailContext gains an optional metricsFor(featureName) returning a MetricsHandle. runProdApp, the worker app and the dev server wire it from the observability meter, so provider plugins can emit their own metrics through the same pipeline.
migration: Code that builds SystemWireDeps itself adds metricsFor (createMetricsForFactory(meter)).

title: Watch supervisor skips and logs accounts whose address does not decrypt
detail: Previously a single such account made the whole account snapshot throw.

title: Inbound mail projections use typed bun-db helpers
detail: Mail-account and mail-thread events upsert through `upsertOnConflict` (`connectedAt` is only written on insert), inbound messages insert through `insertOnConflictDoNothing`. The raw `db/queries/inbound-projections.ts` module is gone.

title: Inbound mail OAuth accounts refresh their access token
detail: `createInboundMailSupervisor` obtains a valid access token via the new `createOAuthAccessTokenManager` before `plugin.fetch`/`plugin.watch` for accounts whose provider declares `oauth` and whose authMethod is `oauth`/`xoauth2`, and passes it as `opts.accessToken` (`fetch`) or `{ accessToken }` (`watch`, 4th argument). `refreshAccessToken` receives an optional 4th argument `{ signal }` (aborted after 30 s); providers must pass it to their token-endpoint fetch, since the foundation awaits the provider and never drops a late result. The foundation has no single construction point for routes and supervisor, so apps that want connect to prime the cache and write under the refresh lock create one manager with `createOAuthAccessTokenManager({ db, secrets })` and pass it to both `createInboundMailSupervisor({ oauthTokens })` and `createInboundMailConnectRoutes({ oauthTokens })`; without it the supervisor builds its own manager and the callback writes the secret without the lock. `InboundAuthError` from `refreshAccessToken` moves the account to `auth_error`; the generic sync-error log and the `token_exchange_failed` response body no longer contain provider error messages.
migration: Apps with OAuth inbound accounts create one `createOAuthAccessTokenManager({ db, secrets })` and pass it as `oauthTokens` to both `createInboundMailSupervisor` and `createInboundMailConnectRoutes`. Provider plugins with a `refreshAccessToken` pass the `signal` from its fourth argument to their token-endpoint fetch.

title: Poll cursor is persisted with the account's tenantId
detail: Several bundled-feature fixes. The inbound-mail watch supervisor now stamps `tenantId` when it first saves a poll cursor, so cursors persist instead of failing on the NOT NULL column. The anonymous queries of managed-pages, template-resolver, seo, compliance-profiles and auth-email-password rate-limit per IP and handler, so one handler no longer drains the bucket of the others. The personal-access-token list loads up to the maximum page size without a pager that could not page. Serial host ids beyond int4 are denied as not found, and the notes forget hook resolves the tenant retention preset once.

title: OAuth callback fails before creating an account when no secrets context is wired
detail: The inbound-mail OAuth callback now checks for a configured secrets context before exchanging the authorization code and creating the mail account. Without secrets the callback answers 500 `secrets_context_missing` and no orphan account is left behind. `form-draft:get` now logs a warning when a stored draft blob fails its schema instead of dropping it silently.

title: Tenant destroy no longer fails on mail-account, inbound-message and mail-thread rows
detail: The inbound-mail tenant-destroy hooks passed the tenant-scoped TenantDb they receive into raw DbRunner helpers, so the app-data stage failed and the tenant ended in destroyFailed. They now use ctx.db methods and declare an escapeHatch for the event-stream archive.

title: createInboundMailConnectRoutes() returns ExtraRouteDefinition[] with static options only
migration: createInboundMailConnectRoutes(options) now returns readonly ExtraRouteDefinition[] (connect route as entry: "user", callback route as entry: "signature") instead of mounting itself on app. options is now static config only - any db/registry/dispatch values previously passed through options are supplied by the framework via the route's deps instead. Replace extraRoutes: (app, deps) => createInboundMailConnectRoutes(options)(app, deps) with extraRoutes: createInboundMailConnectRoutes(options) (spread into the app's route array alongside other route definitions).

title: `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine` bekommt `ctx.tryAppendEvent` — ein savepoint-scope…
detail: `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine` bekommt `ctx.tryAppendEvent` — ein savepoint-scoped Gegenstück zu `ctx.unsafeAppendEvent`, das `VersionConflictError` als `{ ok: false, conflict }` zurückgibt statt zu werfen, ohne die restliche Handler-Transaktion zu poisonen (Bun.SQL/ postgres.js brechen den gesamten `begin()` bei einem ungefangenen Statement- Fehler ab, SQLSTATE 25P02, selbst wenn der JS-Error gefangen wird — `tryAppendEvent` läuft dafür in einem echten `SAVEPOINT`). `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/inbound-mail-foundation`: der `ingest-message`-Handler nutzt `ctx.tryAppendEvent` für den Message-Append — zwei parallele Ingest-Aufrufe für dieselbe `providerMessageId` (Watch-Push vs. Poll-Reconciliation-Überschneidung) liefern jetzt beide `{ duplicate: scheitert (#1038, Finding aus PR-Review #952). - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework@0.150.0 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-headless@0.150.0 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer@0.150.0 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-dispatcher-live@0.150.0 - @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer-web@0.150.0
